hints.title: Two Row Turning Point
hints.text: The first robot chooses an index c where it steps down from the first row to the second row.

hints.title: Remaining Path Options for Second Robot
hints.text: The second robot can only gather points from the top row suffix from c plus one onwards or bottom row prefix up to c minus one.

hints.title: Minimax Prefix Sum Evaluation
hints.text: Robot one minimizes the maximum of top row remaining sum and bottom row accumulated sum across all transition columns c.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def gridGame(self, grid: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        top_sum = sum(grid[0])
        bottom_sum = 0
        ans = float('inf')
        for c in range(len(grid[0])):
            top_sum -= grid[0][c]
            ans = min(ans, max(top_sum, bottom_sum))
            bottom_sum += grid[1][c]
        return ans
```

complexity.time: O(N) where N is the number of columns in the grid
complexity.space: O(1) auxiliary variables for prefix and suffix running totals
complexity.notes: Single pass tracking prefix sum on row one and suffix sum on row zero.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing row sums per column choice takes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Running sum variables achieve linear time and constant auxiliary memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize minimax game structure restricted by two-row geometry.
